translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Kodtobbow ni Disas
Na iddon timpu, si Augusto no hari to Roma, id poponog to suhu no iddos langun no minuvu riyon to intirut kohoriyan din, ko‑ilangan nod polista.
Idda en kos unnon kodlista iddot timpu no si Cirenio pa kos gubernador riyot prubinsya to Siria.
De‑en posid‑uli iddos langun no minuvu riyot bonuwa to kovuyyahan dan amoy'd polista.
Si Jose mandad, id ipanow pomon diyot bonuwa to Nazaret no sakup to Galilea po‑undiyon to Betlehem no sokkad no bonuwa to Judea, su idda en kos bonuwa ni Harin David no kovuyyahan din.
Id poruma rin si Maria nod osowan din no movoddos don iddon timpu.
To riyon don sikandan to Betlehem, nokosasang no id pototobbow si Maria.
Id aanak sikandin to mama no ponganoy rin. Id bukusan din to lamping iddos anak woy id po‑ilogga rin diyot pokannan to oyama, su worad man lugaa riyot baoy nod oowottan to mgo moholiyug.
Id Posaddoo to Ponolihan diyot mgo Tohodtamong to Karnero iddos Moka‑atag to Kodtobbow ni Disas
Iddon bulli, duwon mgo tohodtamong to karnero riyot posobsavan no morani rutun no id tamong to mgo karnero ran.
Na, tigkow duwon ponolihan tod Longaggon no id pokita kandan, woy nolingkus dan to se‑aa to kotuusan tod Longaggon woy oraroy ran no novaakkan.
Piru mid ikahi iddos ponolihan to, “Yo kow'd kovaakki, su id undini a amoy'd posaddoo koniyu to moppiyon dinoggan no od pokovoggoy to dakkoon kahaan to langun no minuvu.
Oyya su inin bulli, id tobbow ron diyot bonuwa ni Harin David iddos Tohodtobbus no idda en so Mesiyas nod Longaggon.
Dos patow no mooggot en inis ikahi ku, oyyos od kokita row iddos anak no id bukusan to lamping woy id po‑ilogga riyot pokannan to oyama.”
Nopongnga idda osenga to ponolihan, tigkow id loppow iddos duma rin no maanmaan no ponolihan pomon diyot datas to langit. Id doong dan kos Monama, kahi ran to,
“Od posivontuhan ta iddos Monama riyot datas to langit, woy ka‑ay to ampow't ingod, duwon kosunayan to mgo minuvu no id kahaa‑i rin.”

To id livod don iddos mgo ponolihan diyot datas to langit, id po‑ikohiyoy iddos mgo tohodtamong to karnero to, “Kuo kid, od undiyon kid to Betlehem amoy'd kokita ta iddos notomanan no id posaddoo keta to Monama nod Longaggon.”
De‑en id lukutlukut dan nid undiyon, woy rutun, nokita ran si Maria woy si Jose woy dos anak no riyot pokannan to oyama.
To nokita ran don iddos anak, id ponudtuu ran diyot langun iddos id ikahi kandan tat ponolihan moka‑atag taddot anak.
Na, iddos langun no nokorinog taddot id ikahi to mgo tohodtamong to karnero, nosoobbuwan.
Piru si Maria, id tota‑aw rin diyot poomdom din iddos langun no notomanan woy inaayun din idda od oonongngon.
Na, id uli iddos mgo tohodtamong to karnero no mid doong woy id posivantug to Monama pomon taddot langun no norinog woy nokita ran. Oyyos bonnaa en iddos id ponudtuu to ponolihan kandan.
Dos Kodpiyod ki Disas diyot Templo
Na, to wau ron no allow iddos anak, id potupuwan sikandin woy id ngoranan ki Disas. Ini en kos ngaran no id ponudtuu taddot ponolihan to waa pa sikandin diyot gottok to inoy rin.
To id inguma ron iddos allow to kodtuman onni Jose woy Maria taddot suhu ni Moises moka‑atag to botasanon to kodlinis to ba‑ay no lammi tobbawi,
mid undiyon sikandan to Jerusalem amoy'd bovuwis. Id piyod dan si Disas amoy id po‑ossa atag to Monama nod Longaggon.
Oyya su ini en kos nosulat diyot Suhu tod Longaggon no mid ungketen to, “Ko‑ilangan no iddos ponganoy no anak no mama, id po‑ossa atag tod Longaggon.”
Na moka‑atag taddot botasanon to kodlinis, id bovuwis sikandan iling taddot no‑ikahi riyot Suhu tod Longaggon no, “Ko‑ilangan no id buwis iddos oruwon limukon o oruwon pispis to soopati.”

Iddon timpu, duwon sokkad no buyyag diyot Jerusalem no id ngoranan ki Simeon no id aangat to kod‑inguma taddot Tohodtobbus amoy'd tovangan iddos koubbaran ni Israel. Motallong sikandin no minuvu woy mopompomakoy woy no‑iroomman to Uhis no Ispiritu.
Tapoy id posaddoo kandin to Uhis no Ispiritu, no konna pa sikandin od patoy taman tod kokita rin iddos Mesiyas no id tandu to Monama.
Ukit to kodpomandu kandin to Uhis no Ispiritu, id usok sikandin diyot templo. Nokosasang en mandad no id piyod onni Jose si Disas amoy'd puungan dan iddos no‑ikahi riyot Suhu moka‑atag kandin.
To nokita ni Simeon iddos anak, id sopipi rin woy id doong din kos Monama. Kahi rin to,

content.text: “Longaggon, notuman don iddos tandu ru koddi no uripon du.
Nopanoy ad ahad kannu ru od ongayon kos umuu ku, oyyos id lonna ron kos ginawa ku.
Su matamata kud en tid kita ka‑ay't id popiyod du no Tohodtobbus
no id panoy ru atag to langun no minuvu to intirut ingod.
Sikandin en iddos od poma‑awang to poomdom to konna mgo Judio no waa poron id kilaa kikow.
Woy ukit kandin, od posivontuhon iddos minuvu ru no koubbaran ni Israel.”

content: De‑en nosoobbuwan iddos amoy woy inoy ni Disas taddot id ikahi ni Simeon moka‑atag kandin.
Na id dasaa si Simeon, no iddos Monama od pokita to kopiyannoy rin diyot kandan. Nopongnga, id osengan din iddos inoy no si Maria, kahi rin to,

content.text: su amoy ukit kandin, mo‑uraa kos minuvu to Israel nod kotobbus, piru mo‑uraa mandad kos od silutan.
Od kilaannon sikandin no patow pomon diyot Monama, piru mo‑uraa mandad kos od kolingasa kandin.
Ukit kandin, od kosorollan iddos poomdom to mo‑uraan minuvu. Woy sikkow Maria, pomon to lampas no kodlanu ru, od geddamon du no iling tid pillak kos pusung du.”

content: Na riyot templo, duwon mandad ba‑ay'n propeta no id ngoranan ki Ana no anak ni Fanuel no lubbad ni Aser. Buyyag don sikandin, woy noko‑osawa sikandin daom da to pittun lahun.
Nopongnga, novau ron sikandin taman ko‑ungkay no waumpuu‑oppat kos idad din. Inaayun sikandin diyot templo su allow bulli, od simba sikandin, od dasaa woy'd puasa.

To idda ra en no timpu, id porani si Ana ki Jose woy ki Maria woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Id ponudtuu rin iddos moka‑atag taddot anak diyot langun no id aangat to allow to kodtobbus to Monama to mgo minuvu riyot Jerusalem.
To notuman don onni Jose woy Maria iddos langun no no‑ikahi riyot Suhu tod Longaggon, id uli ron sikandan diyot kandan no bonuwa to Nazaret no sakup to Galilea.
Na, id tuvu iddos anak woy id monokkaa sikandin, id moraom pe‑en kos koovottan din woy id kahaa‑i sikandin to Monama.
Si Disas diyon to Templo
Na ipat lahun, od undiyon to Jerusalem iddos amoy woy inoy ni Disas amoy'd sakup to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.
To sopuu‑oruwa ron kos idad ni Disas, id sakup sikandan taddon pista, su idda me‑en kos noyaami ran nod puungan.
Nopongnga iddos pista, id logkiyat don si Jose woy si Maria amoy'd uli, piru waa saddoo ran no id polintotuwos bos si Disas.

Kunan dan ko nokoruma rad si Disas taddot ko‑urallan to duma ran nid ipanow. To sokkad don no allow to kod‑ipanow ran, idda pa sikandan nokosaddoo no waa vos dutun si Disas. De‑en id ponaap dan sikandin diyot mgo korumannan dan woy riyot mgo oukuy ran.
Pomon to waa ran sikandin nokita, id poolivod sikandan diyot Jerusalem amoy'd ponaap kandin.
To otollu ron no allow kos mid lihad, idda pa nokita ran sikandin no id ounsad diyot templo duma to mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises. Id pominog sikandin woy mid ointud kandan.
Na iddos langun no nokorinog kandin, nosoobbuwan taddot sinorollan woy mgo tavak din.

To nokokita ki Disas iddos amoy woy inoy rin, oraroy ran no nosoobbuwan. Kahi taddot inoy rin to, “Anak ku, mambot id puungan du ini konami? Siyak woy inis amoy ru, oraroy koyd no no‑ipong to kodponaap kikow.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Mambot id ponaap kow pa koddi? Waa row vo nosorolli no ko‑ilangan en no ka‑ay a to baoy't Amoy ku?”
Piru waa ran nokaabbot taddot kohulugan to id ikahi rin.
Nopongnga idda, id duma si Disas kandan nid uli riyot Nazaret, woy id dumoruma sikandin to langun no suhu ran kandin. Na iddos langun no notomanan, id tota‑aw ni Maria riyot poomdom din.
Na id tuvu si Disas, woy id moraom pe‑en kos koovottan din, woy id kahaa‑i sikandin to Monama woy to mgo minuvu.

footnotes.text: Od kovasa ini riyot Exodo 12:21-27; 23:15; Deuteronomio 16:1-8.
